sections.heading: Introduction
sections.narration: Propranolol is a beta blocker used widely in cardiovascular medicine.

sections.heading: Mechanism of action
sections.narration: Propranolol competitively blocks beta one and beta two adrenergic receptors, reducing the effect of catecholamines.

sections.heading: Pharmacokinetics
sections.narration: Absorption is good, with extensive first pass metabolism in the liver.

sections.heading: Classification
sections.narration: Beta blockers are grouped by receptor selectivity.
